items.title: Oldham 2-0 Port Vale
items.description: Calum Kavanagh's second-half double gave Oldham a flying start to their League Two campaign with a 2-0 home win against relegated Port Vale.

items.title: Bolton beat Preston for first Championship win since 2019
items.description: Sam Dalby and Thierry Gale scored first-half goals as Bolton beat Preston 2-1 to record their first Sky Bet Championship win since March 2019.

items.title: Oxford 2-2 MK Dons
items.description: Ciaron Brown turned in a Gatlin O'Donkor cross deep into stoppage time to earn relegated Oxford United a 2-2 draw against newly-promoted MK Dons at the Kassam Stadium.

items.title: Reading 3-4 Luton
items.description: Substitute Gideon Kodua scrambled home a stoppage-time winner for Luton as they came from behind to snatch a 4-3 victory at Reading.

items.title: Notts County 1-1 Leicester
items.description: Conor Grant's late strike salvaged a deserved point for Notts County as they held former Premier League champions Leicester to a 1-1 draw at Meadow Lane.

items.title: Newport 3-0 Rochdale
items.description: Newport and new manager Hayden Mullins enjoyed a dream start to their League Two campaign with a 3-0 home win over newly-promoted Rochdale.

items.title: Bournemouth to 'do better' after 'disgusting' email
items.description: Bournemouth vow to "do better" after changes to matchday staffing were handled in a manner which "did not reflect the standards we expect".

items.title: Belgian Pocognoli frontrunner to be Scotland boss
items.description: Former Monaco head coach Sebastien Pocognoli is identified by the Scottish FA as their prime candidate to replace Steve Clarke.
